title: Pre-Analysis — Fan Cowl Latch Campaign Closure and Spares Position
abstract: Closed re-analysis of the fan cowl latch standard, run to close out the mandatory campaign and to decide the spares position for the superseded latch, delegated once the mixed installation control was confirmed.

sections.objective: Close out the mandatory latch campaign, decide whether the superseded latch remains available as a spare, and confirm that the prohibition on a mixed installation on one cowl is controlled by something more robust than a placard.
sections.findings_summary: Two items were confirmed and the remaining scope was delegated. The important finding was that the mixed installation prohibition rests entirely on a placard and on a note in the installation task, and neither is visible to a stores system issuing a latch. Nine per cent of the fleet was still at the old standard at the time of the analysis and the superseded latch was still being issued, so the control depended on a technician reading the cowl before ordering. The second finding was that the illustrated part list distinguishes the two shroud standards only by effectivity note behind one part number, which makes the same mistake possible at the ordering stage. Neither needs design work; both need a stores rule and a figure change.
sections.next_steps: Withdraw the superseded latch from open stores issue and make it available only against a recorded cowl standard. Give the two shroud standards distinct item numbers in the figure. Customer services engineering to close out the campaign and report the residual population.

similarity_seeds: preventing two standards of the same part being fitted to one assembly

tasks.title: Establish the residual population at the old standard
Trace how the mixed installation prohibition is enforced

expected_findings.rationale: The prohibition on a mixed installation rests on a placard applied at embodiment and on a note in the installation task, neither of which is visible to a stores system issuing a latch.
expected_findings.resolution: Superseded latch withdrawn from open stores issue and made available only against a recorded cowl standard.

expected_findings.rationale: The figure distinguishes the two shroud standards only by an effectivity note behind one part number, which makes the same ordering mistake possible before a technician ever sees the cowl.
expected_findings.resolution: Distinct item numbers allocated for the two shroud standards.

expected_findings.rationale: The bulletin requires the placard but does not require the cowl standard to be recorded in the aircraft configuration file, which is what a stores rule would key on.
expected_findings.resolution: Recording requirement to be added at campaign closure.

type_data.conclusion: Delegated to customer services engineering for campaign closure. The mixed installation control was the only substantive gap and is a stores rule rather than a design action.
